thread:
emma: Heads-up: during yesterday's private-deploy validation we tripped a shim image vuln alert while doing an emergency KMS switch. Need to capture audit evidence and decide RBAC changes for the shim service account.

ravi: Which vuln scanner flagged it and what severity?

emma: Clairvuln flagged CVE-2025-9999 (libcrypto misuse) as high on image sha256:abc123... We'll quarantine the image but we already ran it as a fallback for ~2 mins. No evidence of key exfil.

carol: Important: compliance needs an unbroken audit trail for the handoff window. Audit-forwarder must produce a signed bundle with timestamps, and we should attest that the shim SA had no escalate-to-root bindings. Also list RBAC roles bound at the moment.

ben: I pulled the kube-audit spool and the forwarder spool. The forwarder kept retries and didn't drop. Quick grep below:```
kubectl -n redwood-control logs audit-forwarder-0 --since=5m | grep -i enqueue
2026-04-12T08:41:02Z INFO enqueue: event=ACCESS KMS_REQUEST keyref=hk-9f2\n
2026-04-12T08:41:15Z INFO enqueue: event=KMS_SWITCH keyref=hk-9f2 -> hk-0b3\n
2026-04-12T08:42:00Z INFO drain: sending bundle parts=3 size=1.2MB\n
```

emma: Good. Can we export rolebindings for the shim svcacct? `kubectl -n redwood-control get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -o wide | grep hsm-shim`
ravi: I ran a dump and attached below. hsm-shim serviceaccount had a namespaced Role "hsm-shim-reader" and a ClusterRoleBinding to "kms-proxy" for DNS resolve only. No cluster-admin.

carol: Then for the artifact we need: (1) signed audit bundle, (2) rolebinding dump, (3) SBOM + scanner output, (4) a short incident timeline, (5) proof that keys were only referenced.

emma: I'll create a signed bundle. Using `gpg --detach-sign` on the bundle and add SHA256 manifest. Planning to redact any nonce values but keep key refs.

ben: Suggestion: avoid opening egress to vendor IPs. Instead patch a narrow netpol to force control-plane to use the shim clusterIP proxy. Here's a policy:```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: force-kms-proxy
  namespace: redwood-control
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: control-plane
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.2.0.0/16
      - podSelector:
          matchLabels:
            app: hsm-shim
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 15001
```

ravi: Minor tweak: ipBlock + podSelector under same to will be ignored; separate entries. Also we should create an egress policy that only allows cluster-dns + shim svc. I'll open a PR.

carol: For RBAC change, compliance asked to add a read-only Audit ACL that logs any token exchange events for the shim SA. We can use OPA gate to deny any exec/port-forward for that SA.

emma: I'll add a short OPA constraint to deny `exec` verbs for `system:serviceaccount:redwood-control:hsm-shim`. Example: `deny[msg] { input.request.kind.kind == "PodExec"; input.request.user == "system:serviceaccount:redwood-control:hsm-shim" }`.

ben: After we assemble the bundle, upload to s3://redwood-compliance/2026-04-12/shim-incident-1755550000/ and link RW-SEC-4988. ops-bot create ticket?

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-SEC-4988: "shim vuln & KMS fallback audit bundle" assigned to @emma and @ben. ETA 48h. :white_check_mark:

ravi: Also run an offline key integrity check: ask KMS vendor to confirm no rewrap requests during the window. If vendor confirms, add as external attestation in the bundle.

carol: Postmortem actions: 1) Add audit-forwarder alert (queue > 300 events), 2) Add RBAC policy preventing shim SA from escalations, 3) Require image SBOM + vulnerability scan before approving any shim image in private deployment, 4) Add e2e canary that verifies control-plane egress to shim svc on each private-deploy rollout.

emma: Doing all the exports now, will redact nonces and sign. Uploading proof and rolebindings to RW-SEC-4988 when ready.

ben: One more: record conntrack metrics around the time window. We saw a short conntrack spike earlier today in netops graphs. That might be root cause for vendor KMS flakiness.

emma: Thanks team. Upload in 30m and then we'll rotate the shim image and block the bad sha in the registry. :thumbsup:
